info.name: Delivez - Mobile App (Production) API Suite
info.description:
PRODUCTION Postman collection for iOS & Android mobile app developers integrating Delivez.

Pre-configured with Production server URL (http://40.81.244.167:3012/api/v1).
Contains all 10 screen-by-screen flows (Splash, OTP Auth, GPS Location, Address Book, Courier, Luggage, Vault, Forgot Something, Tracking, Support).

request.description: Called by Mobile Splash screen to verify API connectivity before opening app UI.
Fetches real-time alert banners, weather delays, or operational notices.
Triggered when user enters phone number. Dispatches SMS OTP and stores {{challengeId}}.
Verifies the OTP and automatically stores {{accessToken}} for all subsequent authenticated screens.
Resends a fresh OTP if the 60-second mobile timer runs out.
Registers a new customer profile.
Returns profile details for the account tab and drawer.
Reverse-geocodes mobile device GPS coordinates to city, area, pincode, and serviceability.
Master call fetching Hero, Quick Action cards, Promo Banner, and Action Chips in 1 request.
Returns all delivery service modules (Courier, Luggage, Vault, Forgot Something).
Quick check if a delivery pincode is covered.
Populates Saved Addresses list (Home, Office, Recent).
Saves a new destination address to user profile.
